result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue where restaurant metadata text overlaps and becomes unreadable.

issues.description: Under the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' listing in the 'Popular right now' section, the delivery time ('25–35 min') and delivery fee ('€0 delivery') text labels overlap each other horizontally, rendering both illegible.
issues.suggestion: Place the delivery time, delivery fee, and category labels in a properly spaced horizontal layout (such as a flex row with gap or inline spans separated by bullet characters) rather than overlapping positions.
